super-earth-federation.title: Federation of Super Earth
super-earth-federation.description: The Federation of Super Earth is the governing human faction of Super Earth and its interstellar territory. It operates under Managed Democracy and directs the Super Earth Armed Forces, including the Helldivers, in the Second Galactic War against the Terminids, Automatons, and Illuminate.

automatons.title: Automatons
automatons.description: The Automatons are a machine civilization and one of the three enemy factions fought by the Helldivers during the Second Galactic War. The Automatons are described as the children of the Cyborgs and share their goal of independence from Super Earth. Their forces combine light infantry with heavily armored troops, vehicles, aircraft, artillery, production facilities, and specialized subfactions such as the Jet Brigade, Incineration Corps, and Cyborg Legion.

terminids.title: Terminids
terminids.description: The Terminids are a rapidly reproducing alien species and one of the three enemy factions fought by the Helldivers during the Second Galactic War. They are successors to the Bugs of the First Galactic War and were selectively bred by Super Earth for Element-710 production before later escaping containment. Their forces rely on swarming attacks, claws, acidic bile, and rapidly evolving specialized strains.

illuminate.title: Illuminate
illuminate.description: The Illuminate are an ancient, highly advanced alien civilization and one of the three enemy factions fought by the Helldivers during the Second Galactic War. Known colloquially as Squids, they possess advanced shielding, stealth, energy weapons, spacecraft, and mind-control technology. Their modern forces include multiple subfactions such as the Mindless Masses, Appropriators, Vote Snatchers, and Invasion Fleet.

cyborgs.title: Cyborgs
cyborgs.description: The Cyborgs are a technologically augmented human faction that rebelled against Super Earth and established their center of power on Cyberstan. They fought Super Earth during the First Galactic War and were defeated, after which surviving Cyborgs were forced into labor on Cyberstan. The later Automatons are described as the children of the Cyborgs, and Cyborg fighters have since returned to active combat as the Cyborg Legion, an Automaton subfaction.
